review_scope: Sequence XML roles/groups plus chronological frame inspection; preliminary small single-camera evaluation. Independent event-boundary review recommended.
definition: A previously carried or deposited bag remains visible after its associated carrier has left the vicinity. Retrieval and attended placement are negative. These are endpoint state labels, not a universal duration rule.
